direction: Expressive chess pieces on turned bases; stylized vintage Action Comics / Archie-inspired brush ink and flat color.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: three-pose production sprite sheet, ONE original CHESS KNIGHT character.
Art direction: old-school American newsstand comic illustration, the friendly expressive linework of mid-century humor comics such as Archie mixed with the bold action poses and primary colors of early Action Comics. Original character only. Clean hand-inked black brush contours of varying width, attractive cartoon drawing, flat saturated golden yellow with one orange shadow plane, a few cream highlights, very sparse grouped hatch strokes. Printed comic charm but clean digital cutout. Medium-simple detail and strongly expressive face.
The character must unmistakably be an actual CHESS KNIGHT PIECE: a sculptural horse head and curved horse neck sitting on a stout round chess pedestal/base. NO human body, NO human legs, NO human armor outfit. Large expressive horse eye and eyebrow, confident slightly cocky smile, a short swept mane, optional very small cape at the back. Keep the classic knight chess silhouette as the entire character. Personality like an enthusiastic brave horse who is slightly overconfident. The base anchors each pose.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 with exactly three equal columns. Same character and same colors/scale in all three cells. Each character fully inside its own cell, generous transparent padding, no overlap, centered pedestal and same feet baseline.
LEFT: idle piece, proud three-quarter profile looking right with expressive eyebrow and grin.
MIDDLE: single dynamic attack illustration, horse neck thrust forward, determined eye, mane and tiny cape sweeping back, strong bold impact-ready pose, pedestal still visible.
RIGHT: single hit/recoil illustration, neck bent back, comic surprised eyes and mouth, pedestal still visible.
Bright GOLD main color, orange shadow, near-black ink, cream eyes and highlight, optional small blue cape.
Genuinely transparent background with clean alpha edges, no smoky background, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no panels, no typography, no realism, no engraving, no filigree, no pixel art, no generic vector icon. Designed to read clearly as a lovable illustrated chess piece in a fast mobile board game.
